paragraph: The Granville Composite delivers a distinctly bearish primary verdict at 31/100 heading into the open, signaling heavy internal erosion across economic and growth drivers despite the lack of an active breadth divergence warning. Systemic weakness is heavily concentrated in key leading sectors, driven by severe underperformance in semiconductor bellwethers (SOXX/SPY at -2.79%), a sharp risk-off rotation in high-beta equities (SPHB/SPLV at -2.01%), and deteriorating transport strength (IYT/SPY at -0.78%). Macro conditions show a market split under the surface; while credit remains orderly with high-yield spreads stable at 2.84% and the spot VIX sits at a calm 19.57 in contango, front-loaded volatility skew (+1.4 points) and falling 10-year breakeven inflation (2.21%) point to building anxiety. This macro backdrop confirms that muted index-level volatility is actively masking a systematic de-risking out of high-beta leadership, further validated by persistent small-cap underperformance at 0.3940. Given the degraded 31/100 composite reading and underlying front-loaded fear, traders should maintain a pronounced downside lean for the session and favor selling faded rallies into structural overhead.
